ProjectRequest.description:
A web project request (FR-001, FR-005).

``description``, ``constraints`` and ``attachments`` have no column on the ``Project`` entity
(SRS 7.1 defines it as id/title/requester_id/state/wrs_version/stack only) - they are the raw
material the future Requirement Analyzer turns into a WRS (FR-020), so the Web Agent records
them on the ``PROJECT_RECEIVED`` event instead of inventing new Project columns.

post.description:
Approve or reject (Approver only, FR-131), then resume the paused project run.

The decision is committed first; re-enqueuing the project lets the runner pick up the paused
graph and resume it with this decision (``runner._resume_input``).

get.description: One blueprint by id.

put.description:
Replace a blueprint with a new, strictly higher version.

``body`` is validated as a full ``BlueprintSpec`` (semver, known tools/checks, permissions
exactly matching SRS section 10) before this ever runs. This additionally checks the path id
matches the body, that the referenced system prompt actually exists, and that the version is
a real bump - never a same-or-lower version, and never a silent in-place overwrite.
